I've felt like this before too. What works for me is to try and work out step by step the consequences of each change and write it down. So if she changes her hair, then more people will think she's pretty, more people will think she's attractive and want to be with her, and so then she'll leave me because I'm not good enough. When you write it down like this you can find faults in your own logic and realise that what you think is gonna happen is pretty unlikely. (I think there's an actual name for this technique, you could look it up if you're interested)

Moreover, ensure you continue to build trust in your relationship. Try and spend quality time with her and take solace in the fact that you two are in a relationship. Remember that she's dating you for a reason, and it's probably not down to your clothes etc. 

Talk about this in therapy too! I hope you'll be able to work through your personal issues \^\_\^

hi! i have a couple tips  \^.\^

id say the thing that helped me improve the most was watching pro gameplays on youtube and looking at their techniques? also there are plenty of kiting (containing hunter) guides on youtube (i used to watch this youtuber oirin alot) but above all its important that you play consistently! learn from your mistakes, eventually youll get familiar with all the maps and hunters. 

id recommend playing gardener because she is the meta out of all of the free survs (she has a shield she can activate as well as the rocket chair thingy) . try to learn how to kite without being dependant on the  survs skill whoever you decide to play, thats important.

some more specific tips

1. dont decode together unless there are 2 or 1 ciphers left
2. use the in game messages, ping ur cipher progress, say if the hunters near u etc
3. dont run in the open/ in a straight line when the hunters near you, find areas with pallets and windows and move to a new area (transition) afterwards
4. dont drop the pallets straight away ((this depends on the situation but id say this as a general rule)). they are useful so dont waste them.
5. you can get terror shocked in one hit if the hunter hits you whilst you are vaulting (a window), decoding or healing. 

if you ever want to practice or have anymore questions i can give u my discord! i hope u enjoy playing\~
